findings.title: Run full input verification before observing X6
findings.reason: The full hashing and per-file committed-input verification after X6 delays the browser launch beyond the observation. Operator activity, another process, or accessibility settings could change during that work.
findings.resolution: Verified against launch/verify call chain; separate fix worker changes ordering and adds controlled test.

otherReviewedContracts: Input seals, separate shipped freezes, calval-before-blind batching, domain validation, snapshots and full unclaimed-endpoint equality were consistent with inspected contracts. Five controlled-process tests passed. No browser/native/exposure/assemble/capture operation ran.
subsequentScope: Coordinator narrowed pre-capture source inventory to executed imports plus runtime sources; final exposure inventory remains unchanged. Separate bounded worker implements and tests before follow-up.
